page.layout: One page of text in a single column. Commentary notes in smaller type run in full width below the top lines, each beginning with a line reference ("lin.", "pag.", "n"). A catchword stands at the right below the last line, and a gathering signature at the foot left.

main_text.p: cat legendum esse, ἀχοικότερος ἐπότε παῖς μὴν λῶ ἡλικίαν, ἀχοικότερος ὃ ἔννυν.
lin.5. καὶ λέγ' ὁρῶν μοι] Malo, καὶ ἂν ὁρῶν μοι ἐψιλό-κομα. ἐψιλύχομαι, vertex.sta fæpè alibi loquitur absolutè.
lin.20. προσεπιλέ[?]ξις] Dispungo, προς ὅπ τὴν ξις. Sic versus est hac particula, epistola 60. καὶ προς τὰς ἐρώτας μαίαν τεσεῖν αὐάρεζον ἔφασκον.
lin.25. ἀλλ' ἔταν] Hemistichium est Homeri ἰλιαδ. B', pag.11.lin.15. ad ἀ ἐι ἀ προςοπελεῖρ] Per primam vocalem ἀ προςοπελεῖρειν.
pag.12.lin.13. τῇ φύσει ... ] Distinguendum, ... ὁ (supple ζῶον.

pag.15.lin.17. καὶ παῖδα ... ] Lege, ... quod vocabulum reperies apud Suidam, ... hic vocat, quem alibi ... enim, ... idem est quod μαγὸς. Pollux lib.11. onomasticon: οἱ μαγοὶ, καὶ τιτθοὶ καλεῖ, καὶ τιθία, μάλιστα δὲ ... vide etiam Hesychium.

n 24. καθάπερ ἔφησεν ὁ Ἀβδηρείτης] Democritum intelligit, quem verisimile est aliquid de Animalibus edisse, præsertim cum in iis tam diligens ille studium posuerit ut patet ex longa illa elegantiq, epistola Hippocratis ad Demagetum.
pag.16.lin.11. ὥραν Διρες] Scribendum, non ὥραν, sed ὥρα Διρες.
lin.21. ἑαυτὸν μηχάνοι] Lego, ὑπηχημένοι. unde ηχίζε τέτλε Hesiodo erratum contrarium fuerat in hoc Cleanthus verse: ἐν σῷ γὰρ ὄλλος ἰσομὲν ὄχω μίμημα λαχόντες.

page.notes: Many Greek words are set small and the scan is too soft to read letter by letter, so the Greek in the notes is marked [?] where uncertain and may contain errors. The first top line is set in the same small type as the notes and is taken as a note. The "ἡχ" beside the signature is read as a catchword. The left and right edges show neighbouring-page edge marks, which were left out.
